title: Click-Clack Cuttlefish
statement: Nestled among tidy, self-built towers of frosted sea glass and swaying amber kelp, this curious little cephalopod spends its days sorting smooth pebbles with rhythmic, thoughtful clicks. Whenever a visitor leans close, its velvety skin ripples with shifting constellations of warm gold and ink-blue light, flashing intricate patterns as if eager to strike up a conversation.
